strategies.name: event_arb
strategies.description: Mutually-exclusive outcome sets: NO baskets when YES bids sum > $1, YES baskets when exhaustive asks sum < $1.

strategies.name: ladder_arb
strategies.description: Monotonicity violations in threshold ladders (P(>a) must be >= P(>b) for a<b).

strategies.name: longshot_fade
strategies.description: Fade overpriced longshots (buy NO) / buy underpriced favorites, net of fees.

strategies.name: expiry_convergence
strategies.description: Buy near-certain favorites shortly before expiry (time-decay convergence to $1).

strategies.name: momentum
strategies.description: Momentum: follow large moves between snapshots.

strategies.name: mean_reversion
strategies.description: Mean reversion: fade large moves between snapshots.

strategies.name: market_making
strategies.description: Passive two-sided quoting on wide spreads with conservative fill model.

strategies.name: weather_nws
strategies.description: Daily high-temperature buckets priced from the free NWS forecast (Normal error model).
